title: 820. Card Flipping Game

examples.explanation: Values 1 and 4 each appear on both sides of some card and are disqualified; the smallest remaining value is 2.
The only value is double-sided on its card, so no good number exists.
No card shows the same value twice, so the minimum of all faces wins.

hints: A value appearing on both faces of any single card can never be the hidden answer.
Collect those forbidden values, then take the minimum over all faces not in the set (0 when empty).
